purpose_field: Licensor grants Licensee a limited, non-exclusive license to use the 'Morgan Stanley' brand/trademark solely to state in public filings, offering materials, advertising and press releases that Licensor (or an affiliate) provides investment advisory services to Licensee.

The agreement establishes the terms under which eGain provides Customer with hosted, web-based access to eGain's software and related hosting/support services for processing and responding to online inquiries and messages from Customer's website users.

The agreement sets up a co-promotion arrangement under which Valeant will deploy its sales force to detail and promote Dova's product DOPTELET (avatrombopag) to certain specialty target professionals in the U.S., in exchange for a promotion fee based on net sales.
This agreement sets out a sponsorship and promotional relationship where WCC will promote XLI's 'Light Sheets' products and technology in exchange for stock and other consideration from XLI.

This agreement appoints Alfa Aesar as the exclusive worldwide distributor of Nanophase Technologies' nanomaterials and dispersions in research quantities for research purposes, with Nanophase retaining rights to sell commercial quantities and provide free samples.

This agreement grants AbbVie an exclusive option to obtain a license to develop and commercialize Harpoon's Licensed Compound (HPN217) and Licensed Products worldwide, with Harpoon conducting initial development activities and AbbVie having rights to exercise the option and take over development and commercialization.

This agreement establishes a sponsorship relationship where WCC will market and promote XLI's 'Light Sheets' technology, including featuring it in television episodes, in exchange for XLI common stock and product supply.
This agreement appoints ALFA AESAR as the exclusive worldwide distributor of NTC's nanomaterial products in research quantities for research purposes.

This agreement establishes a framework for Harpoon to conduct initial development of specific therapeutic compounds and grants AbbVie an exclusive option to acquire a worldwide license to further develop and commercialize the resulting products.

The agreement establishes a sponsorship and promotional relationship under which WCC promotes XLI's Light Sheets products and technology, and each party licenses specified branding to the other for that promotion. XLI provides stock consideration and may provide products for WCC's promotional activities.

NTC appoints Alfa Aesar as its exclusive distributor for worldwide marketing, sale and distribution of specified nanomaterials in Research Quantities for research purposes. The agreement also provides for referrals of Commercial Quantity sales and Custom Services inquiries to NTC.

Harpoon grants AbbVie an exclusive option to obtain worldwide rights to exploit the Licensed Compound and Licensed Products. Harpoon will conduct the initial development programme, after which AbbVie may exercise the option and assume principal development, regulatory, manufacturing and commercialization responsibilities.

The agreement is for West Coast Customs to promote XLI's products and technology, including 'Light Sheets', in their marketing and production activities. The parties aim to mutually benefit from this cooperation.

This agreement is for the sponsorship of CyberShop on Excite's website and network, including the display of promotional links and advertising banners. The agreement outlines the terms and conditions of the sponsorship, including the obligations of both parties and the duration of the agreement.
The agreement is for the development and commercialization of certain licensed compounds and products. Harpoon grants AbbVie an exclusive option to obtain licenses for these compounds and products.
